answer_1.quote: We generate instructions following 6 NLP tasks (Extractive QA, Multiple-choice QA, Summarization, Textual Entailment, Topic Classification, and Sentence Completion), as well as an additional Chain-of-Thought reasoning task ... We propose an automated data construction pipeline for generating high-quality cultural instruction data from raw documents.
answer_1.outputs: cultural instruction pairs (prompts and answers) covering multiple NLG tasks

answer_2.quote: We evaluate ... on benchmarks ... reporting Accuracy, F1, Jensen-Shannon divergence, and Cultural Bias Score (CBS). For the TRUTHFULQA benchmark we also report ROUGE-L scores.

answer_3.quote: To assess the quality of the instructions generated by the tuned BONITO, we prompt LLAMA-3.1-INSTRUCT 70B ... We then prompt LLAMA-3.1-INSTRUCT 70B for its quality labels ... and for cultural‑relevance labels.
methods: Prompting LLAMA-3.1-INSTRUCT to assign quality and cultural‑relevance ratings

answer_4.quote: We hired 5 graduate students for this task ... we performed stratified sampling ... Within 234 samples, LLAMA-3.1-INSTRUCT agrees with humans on 166 samples ... Human annotators provided majority labels for instruction quality.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators labeled each generated instruction according to the same quality rubric used for the model (e.g., Poor, Good, Excellent).
